intent: A dark, monochrome passwordless sign-in card that rises from blur and staggers its contents in reading order, then morphs into a 'Check your inbox' state that staggers in its own right: a letter slides into a drawn envelope, the flap folds shut, a faint trail follows, and the right webmail button appears for the address's domain.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (container queries); one PALETTE object (dark + light, envelope included) → --ml-* CSS variables
stack.animation: motion/react (enter() helper for staggered blocks, measured auto-height, AnimatePresence popLayout, shared layoutId button, motion-value flap fold); every timeout via a useTimeouts hook that clears on unmount

layout.card: max-width 400px, radius 20px, overflow hidden, surface + inset hairline + deep shadow, padding 36/32/32 from 384px container up, 28/24/24 below
layout.form: brand tile (amber hourglass when expired) → heading → subtitle → error banner → label + 44px field → error/typo suggestion → 44px primary button → 'Use a password instead'
layout.sent: 132×104 envelope → centred heading → copy max 34ch → 'Open {provider}' button or quiet sender note → hairline → '← Use a different email' + resend control (44px)
layout.code: hooks useTimeouts, useCooldown, useShake; FormView and SentView sub-components; AutoHeight, Collapse, Envelope, PrimaryButton, ResendButton

color.approach: monochrome; one accent prop (default = theme ink) on the primary button; colour only for meaning: error, the expired warning tile and the 'Sent again' check

dark.label: #cfcfd4
dark.envelope: back #121214, pocket #161618, open flap #1a1a1d, flap #1d1d21, strokes 15% white, paper #ededef, lines #a6a6ad

light.envelope: back #e4e4e7, pocket #f4f4f5, flap #fafafa, strokes 16% ink, paper #ffffff, lines #a1a1aa

color.primary: accent fill with a #0a0a0b or #ffffff label, whichever has the higher WCAG contrast ratio (crossover near luminance 0.18); hover lays a 7% wash of the label colour via motion whileHover

motion.morph: height follows content via ResizeObserver (420ms in-out); the old view exits y −8 with 4px blur (200ms ease-in) while the new view's blocks stagger in (envelope → heading → copy → button label → footer row, 50ms apart from 140ms); the primary button shares a layoutId so it travels instead of re-entering
motion.envelope: paper slides in from −34px (500ms, delay 140ms); flap scaleY −1→1 around its top edge (420ms, delay 620ms) drawn as a back copy (negative) and a front copy (positive); seal scales in; envelope nudges 7px right and back; three trail lines draw and fade (700ms, 50ms stagger); resend replays
motion.invalid: field shakes x 0,−7,6,−4,2,0 over 420ms; message slides down 300ms
motion.resend: countdown digits roll; wait → Resend link → Sending… → Sent again ✓ → new countdown
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms opacity fades; envelope static and closed; no shake
motion.entrance: once at 30% in view: card y 16→0 + blur 10→0 (600ms); then mark → heading → subtitle → field → button → alternate link, 50ms apart from 120ms, each opacity + 10px rise + 6px blur clearing (450ms)

responsive.390px: 24px card padding, copy wraps to two centred lines, back + resend share one row
responsive.1440px: card centred on black with demo controls under it

accessibility: aria-invalid and aria-describedby to the error or typo suggestion
errors and banner role=alert; polite live region for sending, sent and resent
provider buttons are real links with target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer
returning to the form focuses and selects the prefilled address
focus-visible 2px ink outline offset 2px; presses at .97–.98

content.title: Sign in with a link
content.subtitle: No password to forget. We’ll email you a link that signs you straight in.
content.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
content.expired: heading: That link has expired; body: Sign-in links work once and last 15 minutes, so this one’s retired. We’ll send you a fresh one.
content.providers: Gmail (search deep link), Outlook, Proton, iCloud Mail, Yahoo Mail, Fastmail, HEY; providers prop extends
content.typoHint: opens after a 400ms typing pause or on blur, closes immediately when it stops applying
content.typos: gmial/gmal/gamil/gnail → gmail.com, hotmial → hotmail.com, outlok → outlook.com, yahooo → yahoo.com, porton.me → proton.me
content.demo: New visit / Expired link segmented control; @example.com fails

avoid: paper visible under a closed flap
